laterReadmeClarification.note: Source handoff was updated during production to accept native 1254px originals. Initial snapshot is retained; all native originals are delivered.

spec.export: Native-alpha crop, proportional premultiplied Lanczos resize, transparent padding

modelProvenance.ko: 내장 도구가 실제 모델명을 반환하지 않아 모든 이미지를 제작 후보로 기록합니다.
modelProvenance.en: The built-in tool returned no model identity; all images remain production candidates.

effectSummary.ko: 거리 유지와 전리품 회수 속도를 함께 높입니다. 이동속도 +10%. 공격속도 +5%, 몬스터 처치 골드 +10%, 영웅 처치 경험치 +5%.
effectSummary.en: Improve spacing and loot collection speed. Movement speed +10%. Attack speed +5%, monster gold +10%, and hero kill XP +5%.

items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original HELLSCRIPT dark gothic game inventory icon. Make exactly one coherent isolated subject, not an icon sheet. Deliver a square 1024 by 1024 PNG master with native true transparent alpha, including all internal empty space. Keep EVERY nontransparent pixel within x=136..887 and y=136..887, centered in the central 74 percent. The subject should occupy about 70 percent of the canvas. Large immediately readable silhouette at 64px, few broad forms, restrained details. Painterly dark gothic worn materials, strong warm ivory edge light from upper left and deep readable shadows; no soft ambient aura. No text, letters, numbers, runes resembling writing, watermark, UI, enclosing frame, border, scenery, background, solid backdrop, checkerboard, floor, ground plane, cast shadow, particles, detached decoration or glow outside the object. Transparent surrounding and interior holes must remain genuinely transparent. Match the subdued aged leather and iron tonal weight of the existing HELLSCRIPT equipment reference; create original art, do not copy any reference icon. Set identity: Wandering Hunter. Shared visual language: Dark tawny waxed leather and weathered brass. Repeat a forward split-leaf arrow on every piece, with lean asymmetric folds suggesting movement and collection. Subject: a sculpted brass split-leaf arrow with one swept-back leather tassel, a single coherent symbolic object. Create a physical symbolic emblem, no background medallion or circular frame. Gameplay inspiration only, do not write it in the image: Improve spacing and loot collection speed.

normalization.operation: Native-alpha crop, proportional premultiplied Lanczos resize, transparent padding

effectSummary.ko: 기본 사격으로 복수를 쌓고 주력 사격에 추가 화살을 연결합니다. 기본 사격 직접 적중 시 6초간 복수 1중첩을 얻습니다. 최대 5중첩이며 중첩당 A01·A02 직접 피해 +3%. 재획득하면 전체 지속시간을 갱신합니다. 복수 중첩당 이동속도 +2%, 최대 10%. 복수가 5중첩인 A01·A02 시전의 첫 적중 대상에게 0.1초 간격으로 D25% 물리 화살 3발을 추가합니다. 시전당 1회, 2초에 1회입니다. 복수는 소비하지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: Build Vengeance with basic shots, then attach extra arrows to core shots. Basic-shot direct hits grant one Vengeance stack for 6 seconds, up to five. Each adds 3% A01/A02 direct damage; new stacks refresh the full duration. Movement speed +2% per Vengeance stack, up to 10%. At five Vengeance, an A01/A02 cast adds three 25% D physical arrows at 0.1-second intervals to its first target. Once per cast with a 2-second cooldown; Vengeance is retained.

effectSummary.en: Rotate Fireball, Blizzard, and Chain Lightning, then release a combined burst. Casting a different M01/M02/M03 within 8 seconds grants that skill 12% damage. All three elements within 8 seconds reset the history and grant one 6-second charge. The next offensive skill's first hit releases one 2.5 m burst for 40% D each of fire, cold, and lightning. Charge creation cooldown: 6 seconds.
